cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Clinical Research Coordinator to join our team.
Do you love patient care? Are you a LPN or RN, but are tired of the demands of working in a healthcare setting? Have you ever explored using your clinical skills differently? Clinical Research allows a more flexible schedule for healthcare providers interested in a dynamic and fast paced environment that is on the cutting edge of medicine.
Sound like you? Then you might be a great fit for a Clinical Research Coordinator role with [Company name masked].
We are looking for a positive and innovative Clinical Research Study Coordinator (Research Coordinator) to lead in the coordination, management and conduct of nephrology clinical research trials in dialysis centers and physicians practices. [Company name masked] is a Renal Research site network conducting clinical trials across the country. [Company name masked] prides itself on a culture of growth, transparency and feedback and would want our leaders to do that same. We want a teammate who is compassionate, purposeful and motivated by meaningful work.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Accountable for the successful execution of clinical trials through all phase of the study: enrollment, maintenance and close out. Responsible for performing research procedures according to the study protocol and working in partnership with the physician investigator to coordinate research activities. Serves as a liaison between the physicians (Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator), study sponsors and [Company name masked] facility teammates. Responsible to deliver or exceed project enrollment targets for clinical research studies at their site. Responsible for accurate and timely data entry into the electronic data entry systems. Responsible for timely resolution of all data queries to meet project timelines for database lock. Demonstrates compliance with good clinical practice (GCP) and applicable law, and verifies that study teams comply with GCP and applicable law. Demonstrates adherence to [Company name masked] standard operating procedures and policies and with the standards customary in the clinical research industry. Understands and promotes compliance with all applicable healthcare and research regulations.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 1 year of clinical research experience or equivalent experience
Full vaccination against COVID-19 or a medical/religious exemption. Teammates with a medical/religious exemption may need to submit to weekly COVID-19 testing
Reliable transportation to travel between local research sites
Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adjust priorities appropriately in an evolving work environment with shifting time frames; self-starter with high degree of initiative, urgency, and follow through
Experience in managing confidential information and/or issues using discretion and judgment
Preferred Requirements
BS/BA
Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (SOCRA or ACRP)

[Company name masked] is a Renal Research site network conducting clinical trials across the country. [Company name masked] prides itself on a culture of growth, transparency and feedback. We want a teammate who is compassionate, purposeful and motivated by meaningful work.
cond_0324.responsibilities:
Coordinate the successful execution of clinical trials through all phases of the study: enrollment, maintenance and close out.
Work alongside the physician investigator to carry out research procedures according to the study protocol and coordinate research activities.
Serve as a liaison between the physicians (Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator), study sponsors and [Company name masked] facility teammates.
Coordinate with site teams to meet or exceed project enrollment targets for clinical research studies.
Collaborate with the team to ensure accurate and timely data entry into the electronic data entry systems.
Support timely resolution of all data queries to meet project timelines for database lock.
Help ensure compliance with good clinical practice (GCP) and applicable law, and work with study teams to verify they comply with GCP and applicable law.
Adhere to [Company name masked] standard operating procedures and policies and to the standards customary in the clinical research industry.
Share responsibility for promoting compliance with all applicable healthcare and research regulations.
cond_0324.requirements:
BS/BA preferred.
Minimum 1 year of clinical research experience or equivalent experience.
Full vaccination against COVID-19 or a medical/religious exemption is required. Teammates with a medical/religious exemption may need to submit to weekly COVID-19 testing.
Reliable transportation to travel between local research sites.
Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adjust priorities appropriately in an evolving work environment with shifting time frames; self-starter with high degree of initiative, urgency, and follow through.
Experience in managing confidential information and/or issues using discretion and judgment.
Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (SOCRA or ACRP) – preferred.
cond_0324.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.
cond_0324.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.

Clinical Research allows a more flexible schedule for healthcare providers interested in a dynamic and fast paced environment that is on the cutting edge of medicine.
Sound like you? Then you might be a great fit for a Clinical Research Coordinator role with [Company name masked].
We are looking for a positive and innovative Clinical Research Study Coordinator (Research Coordinator) to lead in the coordination, management and conduct of nephrology clinical research trials in dialysis centers and physicians practices. [Company name masked] is a Renal Research site network conducting clinical trials across the country. [Company name masked] prides itself on a culture of growth, transparency and feedback and would want our leaders to do that same. We want a teammate who is compassionate, purposeful and motivated by meaningful work. Most people become stronger in this kind of clinical research work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0491.responsibilities: Accountable for the successful execution of clinical trials through all phase of the study: enrollment, maintenance and close out. Responsible for performing research procedures according to the study protocol and working in partnership with the physician investigator to coordinate research activities. Serves as a liaison between the physicians (Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator), study sponsors and [Company name masked] facility teammates. Responsible to deliver or exceed project enrollment targets for clinical research studies at their site. Responsible for accurate and timely data entry into the electronic data entry systems. Responsible for timely resolution of all data queries to meet project timelines for database lock. Demonstrates compliance with good clinical practice (GCP) and applicable law, and verifies that study teams comply with GCP and applicable law. Demonstrates adherence to [Company name masked] standard operating procedures and policies and with the standards customary in the clinical research industry. Understands and promotes compliance with all applicable healthcare and research regulations.
cond_0491.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 1 year of clinical research experience or equivalent experience
Full vaccination against COVID-19 or a medical/religious exemption. Teammates with a medical/religious exemption may need to submit to weekly COVID-19 testing
Reliable transportation to travel between local research sites
Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adjust priorities appropriately in an evolving work environment with shifting time frames; self-starter with high degree of initiative, urgency, and follow through
Experience in managing confidential information and/or issues using discretion and judgment

BS/BA
Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (SOCRA or ACRP)

We want a teammate who is compassionate, purposeful, and motivated by meaningful work. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical trial processes and research protocols.
cond_0517.responsibilities: Accountable for the successful execution of clinical trials through all phases of the study: enrollment, maintenance and close out. Responsible for performing research procedures according to the study protocol and working in partnership with the physician investigator to coordinate research activities. Serves as a liaison between the physicians (Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator), study sponsors and [Company name masked] facility teammates. Responsible to deliver or exceed project enrollment targets for clinical research studies at their site. Responsible for accurate and timely data entry into the electronic data entry systems. Responsible for timely resolution of all data queries to meet project timelines for database lock. Demonstrates compliance with good clinical practice (GCP) and applicable law, and verifies that study teams comply with GCP and applicable law. Demonstrates adherence to [Company name masked] standard operating procedures and policies and with the standards customary in the clinical research industry. Understands and promotes compliance with all applicable healthcare and research regulations.
cond_0517.requirements: BS/BA preferred. Minimum 1 year of clinical research experience or equivalent experience. Full vaccination against COVID-19 or a medical/religious exemption is required. Teammates with a medical/religious exemption may need to submit to weekly COVID-19 testing. Reliable transportation to travel between local research sites. Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adjust priorities appropriately in an evolving work environment with shifting time frames; self-starter with high degree of initiative, urgency, and follow through. Experience in managing confidential information and/or issues using discretion and judgment. Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (SOCRA or ACRP) – preferred.

[Company name masked] is a Renal Research site network conducting clinical trials across the country. [Company name masked] prides itself on a culture of growth, transparency and feedback. We want a teammate who is compassionate, purposeful and motivated by meaningful work.
cond_0531.responsibilities:
Coordinate the successful execution of clinical trials through all phases of the study: enrollment, maintenance and close out.
Work in partnership with the physician investigator to perform research procedures according to the study protocol and coordinate research activities.
Serve as a liaison between the physicians (Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator), study sponsors and [Company name masked] facility teammates.
Collaborate with site teams to meet or exceed project enrollment targets for clinical research studies.
Support accurate and timely data entry into the electronic data entry systems.
Work with the team to ensure timely resolution of all data queries to meet project timelines for database lock.
Uphold compliance with good clinical practice (GCP) and applicable law, and help ensure that study teams comply with GCP and applicable law.
Follow [Company name masked] standard operating procedures and policies and the standards customary in the clinical research industry.
Help promote compliance with all applicable healthcare and research regulations.
cond_0531.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 1 year of clinical research experience or equivalent experience.
Reliable transportation to travel between local research sites.
Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adjust priorities in an evolving work environment; self-starter with a high degree of initiative, urgency, and follow through.
Experience managing confidential information and/or issues using discretion and judgment.
Full vaccination against COVID-19 or a medical/religious exemption. Teammates with a medical/religious exemption may need to submit to weekly COVID-19 testing.
Preferred Requirements
BS/BA degree.
Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (SOCRA or ACRP).
cond_0531.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.
